title.en: OpenAI Strengthens Security for Frontier Model Training Environment

excerpt.zh: OpenAI已强化前沿模型训练环境的隔离机制，通过离线世界、防御纵深和前沿模型红队测试，防止越界行为。该研究环境仍无互联网访问，持续红队以应对未来威胁。

text.zh: OpenAI如何强化前沿模型训练环境的安全性
text.en: OpenAI Strengthens Security for Frontier Model Training Environment

text.zh: OpenAI日前发布了其前沿模型训练环境的强化措施，强调通过隔离机制和红队测试来保护这些研究环境。这些环境用于训练和评估能力尚未完全对齐的前沿模型。
text.en: OpenAI has released an update on strengthening the security of its frontier model training environments, focusing on containment and red-teaming to protect research settings for training and evaluating powerful but not yet fully aligned models.

text.zh: 作者强调，训练环境与用户使用的发布模型不同，因为开发中的模型可能尚未完成安全和对齐训练。OpenAI通过这些研究环境测试模型，并进行红队来发现和修复潜在弱点。
text.en: The post stresses that these research settings differ from those for released customer models, as development-stage models have not yet completed safety and alignment training. OpenAI tests models in these environments and uses red-teaming to uncover and remediate weaknesses.

text.zh: OpenAI已停止向研究环境提供互联网访问，并实施了严格的防御纵深策略，包括离线世界、微虚拟机和监控系统，以确保即使单个控制失败，隔离也能保持。红队实验发现并修复了多个漏洞。
text.en: OpenAI has implemented a no-internet policy for research environments and layered defenses including offline worlds, microVMs, and monitoring. Red-teaming experiments uncovered and remediated vulnerabilities, with the effort now part of ongoing safety evaluations.

text.zh: 这种方法面临的主要限制是，未来更强大的模型可能会发现尚未已知的漏洞；OpenAI计划持续进行红队测试以应对这一挑战。
text.en: The primary limitation is that increasingly capable models may discover unknown vulnerabilities. OpenAI views continuous red-teaming as essential to long-term resilience.
